{{Otheruses|Chief of State}}
[[File:MonMothma-TEC.jpg|thumb|250px|Mon Mothma, first and only Chief of State of the Alliance to Restore the Republic]]
'''Chief of State''' (sometimes '''Chief Councilor''', referring to the [[Advisory Council (Alliance)|Advisory Council]]<ref name="Radio">{{RJRadio|Pattern and Web}}</ref>) was the title given to the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. For the entirety of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] held the position of Alliance Chief of State.

==Powers and abilities==
The [[Chief of State]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was an elected [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictatorship]]. Throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] held the position of Chief of State. She had virtually unlimited authority over the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Civil Government]], although checks and balances were in place to ensure she did not overstep her position. Her decisions could be overturned by the [[Advisory Council (Alliance)|Advisory Council]] with a two-thirds majority, in which case Mothma was required to step down from the position of Chief of State. The Chief of State position was up for election every two [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Each [[Allied Command]] had a single vote and the victor was elected by a simple majority vote.<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
